rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the structure made by a spider.

example.english: There’s a spider web in the corner of the room.
example.traditional: 間房個角落有張蜘蛛網。
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 go3 gok3 lok6 jau5 zoeng1 zi1 zyu1 mong5

rows.note: Use this for an interconnected system of people, places, or things.

example.english: They built a web of business contacts across Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 佢哋建立咗一個遍布全港嘅商業網絡。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gin3 lap6 zo2 jat1 go3 pin3 bou3 cyun4 gong2 ge3 soeng1 jip6 mong5 lok6

rows.note: Use this for a deliberate, usually harmful plot or scheme rather than a neutral plan.

example.english: I finally saw through their web of deceit.
example.traditional: 我終於睇穿咗佢哋嘅陰謀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 tai2 cyun1 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 jam1 mau4

rows.note: Use this bare noun for a mesh or lattice structure, rather than the spider-specific 蜘蛛網.

example.english: This web has a hole in it; can it be repaired?
example.traditional: 呢張網有個窿，補唔補得返？
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 mong5 jau5 go3 lung1 bou2 m4 bou2 dak1 faan1
